extras: Requires manual file upload; note that this tool may require deDRM, which is legally restricted in some regions.
intentEvidence: Kindle Vocab is an Obsidian plugin that lets you import vocabulary lookups from your Kindle device
motivation: Ideal for learners who want to build a personal vocabulary library and review it directly within Obsidian.
problem: Learners need a way to import vocabulary lookups from their Kindle reading habits into a structured, reviewable format within Obsidian.
summary: Kindle Vocab imports vocabulary lookups from Kindle devices and converts them into structured, interactive Markdown notes for personal vocabulary building.
